text: Various presentations and announcements will be made at the City Council meeting.

Various presentations, introductions and announcements were made to City Council on June 26, 27, 28 and 29, 2018. June 26, 2018 Councillor Megardichian, during the evening session of the meeting, thanked Members of Council for their support at her first City Council meeting. June 27, 2018 Speaker Nunziata, during the morning session of the meeting, called upon Mayor John Tory to come forward to address Council on the retirement of Joanne Campbell, Executive Director of the Toronto Police Services Board. Mayor Tory spoke of Ms. Campbell's contributions to the Toronto Police Services Board. Mayor Tory, on behalf of Members of Council and the residents of Toronto, thanked Ms. Campbell for her service and extended Joanne Campbell best wishes for a happy retirement.
